lines: Supreme-light-bodied — thought-power, Lord — goddess supreme;
hers indeed the spreading — all goddesses, Brahmī-led.
l4.sanskrit_cite: paramaprakāśavapuṣo vimarśaśaktiḥ prabho parā devī | asyā eva prasaraḥ sarvā brāhmyādikā devyaḥ

l4.sanskrit_cite: dahanajalāmṛtalekhāviṣādi bibhrat tvam ādiśasy etat | viśvaṃ viruddham api saccidrūpe mayi virudhyate naitat

lines: Knowing-thread loosed, sapless knower-crowd —
sense-skull-garlanded You show — as it were — to us, Lord.

So shield-clash shown — point us, Lord.
